test_share_icon_visible_in_fullscreen.title: Verify the share icon is in the fullscreen control bar

steps.action: Open a camera tile in fullscreen.
steps.expected: The control bar carries exactly one share icon (icon-share).

test_settings_icon_visible_in_fullscreen.title: Verify the settings icon is in the fullscreen control bar

steps.action: Open a camera tile in fullscreen.
steps.expected: The control bar carries exactly one settings icon (Setting).

test_overlays_icon_visible_in_fullscreen.title: Verify the overlays icon is in the fullscreen control bar

steps.action: Open a camera tile in fullscreen.
steps.expected: The control bar carries exactly one overlays icon.

test_live_indicator_in_fullscreen.title: Verify the live indicator and clock for a live camera stream

steps.action: Open a camera tile in fullscreen.
steps.expected: The player reads as streaming in live mode, and the bar's clock shows today's date.

test_control_container_visible.title: Verify the main control bar carries its measured icon set

steps.action: Open a camera tile in fullscreen.
steps.expected: The control bar carries the exit, Live, date picker, share, Bookmark, sequence, Search, overlays, Setting and bookmarks-dots icons.

test_volume_control_clickable.title: Verify the volume control toggles mute and back

steps.action: Open a camera tile in fullscreen and read the volume icon.
steps.expected: It shows the muted icon (streams start muted).

steps.action: Click it, then click it again.
steps.expected: The icon switches to the volume-on icon, then back to muted.

test_exit_and_reenter_fullscreen.title: Verify exiting fullscreen and re-entering works

steps.action: Open a camera tile in fullscreen, then exit.
steps.expected: The exit button is gone and the Views tab bar is back.
The stream plays again (its time advances).

test_bookmarks_toggle_opens_panel.title: Verify the bookmarks dots icon opens/closes the panel

steps.action: Open a camera tile in fullscreen and click the bookmarks dots icon.
steps.expected: The bookmarks panel opens (its rows are listed when the camera has bookmarks).
The rows are gone and the stream still plays.

steps.action: Navigate to Views > Live Playback Controls

steps.action: Wait for the page to fully render

steps.action: Verify fullscreen works is displayed and functions correctly
steps.expected: Fullscreen works is displayed as expected (on second camera tile)

steps.action: Set up precondition: on second camera tile
steps.expected: Precondition is met (on second camera tile)

steps.action: Verify no errors or unexpected behavior occurred
steps.expected: Page remains stable with no console errors

test_timeline_elements_present.title: Verify timeline-related elements exist in fullscreen

steps.action: On Views, open a camera tile in fullscreen.
steps.expected: The stream plays live, the bar shows the live-mode pause control, and the timeline shows at least three hh:mm labels.
